Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The agent made a factual error in the physics data used for the calculation. It claimed that the rolling resistance coefficient ($c_r$) for sand is approximately 0.003, whereas in reality, rolling on sand significantly increases resistance due to deformation and hysteresis, typically resulting in a $c_r$ much higher than on smooth surfaces (often 0.1 to 0.5 or more). Because the agent incorrectly assumed sand reduces resistance, it logically concluded the truck would roll faster, leading to the wrong answer (B) instead of the correct answer (A).
